triples.tail_surface: Lead the water deflector (11) over the shaft until it touches the cover under bearing (26) and then further 1-1.5 mm towards the cover under bearing.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将挡水圈套入轴直至接触轴承下盖再推进1-1.5mm
triples.evidence_text: 1. Lead the water deflector (11) over the shaft until it touches the cover under bearing (26) and then further 1-1.5 mm towards the cover under bearing.

triples.tail_surface: Assemble bearing cover and rear cover. Do not fasten bearing cover and electric motor until the motor has been mounted and the shaft can rotate freely without.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 组装轴承盖和后盖且在电机安装并确认轴可自由转动前不要紧固
triples.evidence_text: 2. Assemble bearing cover and rear cover. Do not fasten bearing cover and electric motor until the motor has been mounted and the shaft can rotate freely without.

triples.tail_surface: Clean the recess in the rear cover.
triples.evidence_text: 1. Clean the recess in the rear cover.

triples.tail_surface: Remove the protective coating of the seat without scratching the lapped surface and lubricate the outer rubber L-ring on the seat with a thin layer of silicone grease. Use a brush and ensure that no silicone grease ends up at the slide surface.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 去除密封座保护涂层且不划伤研磨面并用硅脂薄涂外橡胶L型圈且避免硅脂沾到滑动面
triples.evidence_text: 2. Remove the protective coating of the seat without scratching the lapped surface and lubricate the outer rubber L-ring on the seat with a thin layer of silicone grease. Use a brush and ensure that no silicone grease ends up at the slide surface.
